# Rose Pine Minimal

Rose Pine Minimal gives Obsidian a minimal interface in soft, cozy tones. Dark (Main) and Light (Dawn) variants are both available, and the description records that the theme changes colours only, preserving Obsidian's native feel.

![Rose Pine Minimal screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olivertedwards/rose-pine-obsidian/HEAD/cover-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Rose Pine Minimal"
    author: "olivertedwards"
    repo:   "olivertedwards/rose-pine-obsidian"
    slug:   "rose-pine-minimal"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/rose-pine-minimal"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/olivertedwards/rose-pine-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olivertedwards/rose-pine-obsidian/HEAD/cover-small.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply Rosé Pine Minimal to Obsidian for a clean, minimal interface with soft, cozy tones. Switch between Dark (Main) and Light (Dawn) variants while preserving Obsidian’s native feel by changing colors only."
}
```
